dedupe_keys.name: oecd crude oil production kaggle snapshot

description: Mario Caesar republishes an OECD crude-oil production indicator as a CSV snapshot. The description defines production after removal of impurities, including crude oil, natural-gas liquids and additives, measured in thousand tonnes of oil equivalent. Coverage is country-level production, but the card does not state country membership, time endpoints or frequency. Kaggle lists one CSV file and declares Open Database and Database Contents licences without versions; access is free. A limitation is that the original OECD indicator address returned access-denied responses in the shell and redirected to a general IEA explorer through the web reader. Thus the current primary series and equivalence of snapshot values were not confirmed. The card also contains an unrelated COVID-19 heading. Simulation uses include historical fuel-production scenarios after checking the table. It complements data-eia-petroleum-supply-and-prices with an internationally defined production indicator. No data values or national completeness were checked.
